title: RLC 串联电路：分电压可以大于总电压
statement: RLC 串联电路接在正弦电压源 V̇_s = 100∠0° V（有效值）上，ω = 1000 rad/s，R = 6 Ω，L = 16 mH，C = 125 µF。
求电流 I 的有效值、电感电压 V_L 和电容电压 V_C 的有效值，并判断电路的性质。

questions.explain: V_L = X_L·I = 16 × 10 = 160 V——比电源电压 100 V 还大。
V_C = X_C·I = 8 × 10 = 80 V。V_L 与 V_C 反相，相量相加时部分抵消：V_L − V_C = 80 V。

questions.ask: 电路呈什么性质？为什么 V_L 可以大于电源电压 100 V？
choices: 感性；KVL 是相量相加，V_L 与 V_C 反相相互抵消，有效值不能直接相加
容性；因为 V_C 小于 V_L
感性；这说明计算有误，分电压不可能超过总电压
choiceExplain: 判断标准弄反了：V_L > V_C 说明 X_L > X_C，X > 0，电路呈感性；只有 V_C > V_L 时才是容性。
“分电压不超过总电压”只对同相的电压（如纯电阻串联）成立；这里 V̇_L 与 V̇_C 反相，相量相加时大部分抵消，计算没有错。
questions.explain: X = X_L − X_C = 8 Ω > 0，电路呈感性，电压超前电流 53.13°。相量 KVL：V̇_s = V̇_R + V̇_L + V̇_C，其中 V̇_L、V̇_C 方向相反，所以 V_s = √(60² + (160 − 80)²) = 100 V。

hints: 先求 X_L = ωL、X_C = 1/(ωC)，再写 Z = R + j(X_L − X_C)。
I = V/|Z|，各元件电压有效值 V_R = RI、V_L = X_L·I、V_C = X_C·I。
solution: **5. 验算（相量 KVL）。** V̇_R 与 İ 同相，V̇_L 超前 İ 90°，V̇_C 滞后 İ 90°。所以 V_s = √(V_R² + (V_L − V_C)²) = √(60² + 80²) = 100 V ✓。

en.title: Series RLC: a part voltage can exceed the total
statement: A series RLC circuit is driven by the sinusoidal source V̇_s = 100∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R = 6 Ω, L = 16 mH, C = 125 µF.
Find the rms current I, the rms inductor voltage V_L and the rms capacitor voltage V_C, and decide whether the circuit is inductive or capacitive.

questions.explain: V_L = X_L·I = 16 × 10 = 160 V — larger than the 100 V source.
V_C = X_C·I = 8 × 10 = 80 V. V_L and V_C are in antiphase, so they partly cancel in the phasor sum: V_L − V_C = 80 V.

questions.ask: Is the circuit inductive or capacitive, and how can V_L exceed the 100 V source?
choices: Inductive; KVL adds phasors — V_L and V_C are in antiphase and cancel, so rms values do not add
Capacitive, because V_C is smaller than V_L
Inductive; it means the calculation is wrong, a part voltage can never exceed the total
choiceExplain: The criterion is reversed: V_L > V_C means X_L > X_C, so X > 0 and the circuit is inductive; it would be capacitive only if V_C > V_L.
"A part voltage never exceeds the total" holds only for voltages in phase (e.g. resistors in series); here V̇_L and V̇_C are in antiphase and largely cancel, so nothing is wrong.
questions.explain: X = X_L − X_C = 8 Ω > 0, so the circuit is inductive and the voltage leads the current by 53.13°. Phasor KVL: V̇_s = V̇_R + V̇_L + V̇_C with V̇_L and V̇_C pointing in opposite directions, so V_s = √(60² + (160 − 80)²) = 100 V.

hints: First find X_L = ωL and X_C = 1/(ωC), then Z = R + j(X_L − X_C).
I = V/|Z|; the rms element voltages are V_R = RI, V_L = X_L·I, V_C = X_C·I.
solution: **5. Check (phasor KVL).** V̇_R is in phase with İ, V̇_L leads İ by 90° and V̇_C lags İ by 90°. So V_s = √(V_R² + (V_L − V_C)²) = √(60² + 80²) = 100 V ✓.
X_L > X_C, so the circuit is **inductive**.
